skylyrics.ui.beli_s_skylyrics_shows_the_: Beli's SkyLyrics shows the words of whatever song you are playing, floating in the Minecraft sky. It is free and open source (AGPL licence).
skylyrics.ui.the_song_comes_from_your_mu: The song comes from your music app through MPRIS, the same Linux feature your media keys use, so Spotify, browsers and most players work. Lyrics come from LRCLIB, a free community lyrics library, and are saved on your computer for next time.
skylyrics.ui.on_windows_the_song_comes_f: On Windows the song comes from the media controls that pop up when you press a media key, so Spotify, browsers and most players work. Lyrics come from LRCLIB, a free community lyrics library, and are saved on your computer for next time.
skylyrics.ui.works_with_sodium_iris_and_: Works with Sodium, Iris and shader packs.
skylyrics.ui.no_lyrics_found_for_this_so: No lyrics found for this song
skylyrics.ui.nothing_is_playing_turn_on_: Nothing is playing. Turn on the demo song in Music to try it.
skylyrics.ui.previewing_click_or_press_a: Previewing. Click or press any key to go back.
skylyrics.ui.play_a_song_in_spotify_a_br: Play a song in Spotify, a browser or any player
skylyrics.ui.the_word_being_sung_grows_a: The word being sung grows a little
skylyrics.ui.on_macos_the_mod_asks_the_s: On macOS the mod asks the Spotify and Music apps what's playing. The first time, macOS asks if Minecraft may control them: click OK. Browsers and other players can't be seen on a Mac. Lyrics come from LRCLIB, a free community lyrics library, and are saved on your computer for next time.
skylyrics.ui.allow_minecraft_to_control_: Allow Minecraft to control %s in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation
skylyrics.ui.waiting_for_spotify_or_musi: Waiting for Spotify or Music. If macOS asks to let Minecraft control them, click OK
